NetworkAdapters.description: The group's network adapters, each named by the Name of its chassis record and of its NSM_NetworkAdapter record.

PCIeTopologies.description: Names of the PCIe fabrics the group's network adapters switch through.

IpmiName.description: Short sensor name reported over IPMI by phosphor-host-ipmi.

NsmKind.description: nsmd device kind: the key of nsmd's compiled device table, which gives the NSM device type, role and base feature list.

NsmKindPending.description: Device kinds whose entity file publishes an NSM_Telemetry item although nsmd has no entry for the kind in its device table yet; nsmd skips the item until it has one.

NsmFeatureSettings.description: One feature's settings, published as a{sv}: Enabled enables or disables the feature, every other key sets that feature parameter.

NSM_Telemetry.description: The NSM device record of an entity file: device identity and the template variables of nsmd's base feature list for the kind, plus the entity's deviation from that list.

Name.description: Record name; nsmd takes the device name from the entity.

EID.description: MCTP endpoint ID of the device.

ParentChassis.description: Parent chassis name, the {parentChassis} template variable.

Disable.description: Features of the base feature list that this entity does not have.

ParameterOverrides.description: Feature id to the settings that differ from the base feature list.

BridgeName.description: Template variable: name of the MCTP bridge in front of the device.

LeakDetectorChassis.description: Template variable: chassis that owns the device's leak detectors.

LocationCode.description: Template variable: location code of the device.

LocationContext.description: Template variable: location context of the device.

MemoryLocationCode.description: Template variable: location code of the device's memory.

NvLinkCount.description: Template variable: number of NVLinks of the device.

PlatformPrefix.description: Template variable: the platform's device-name prefix.

PortCount.description: Template variable: number of network ports of the device.

PortLocationCodeMap.description: Template variable: location code of each network port, by port index.

PortLocationContext.description: Template variable: location context of the network ports.

PortLocationReference.description: Template variable: LocationReference value of the network ports.

PortNameMap.description: Template variable: name of each network port, by port index.

ProcessorModuleName.description: Template variable: processor module that contains the device.

SwitchName.description: Template variable: name of the device's PCIe switch object.

ZoneChassisName.description: Template variable: zone chassis the device reports into.

NSM_Policy.description: A platform's NSM feature choices for one device kind, consumed by nsmd. Entries apply in order; a later entry wins.

Policy.description: Policy entries, each published as its own Policy<N> interface.

Devices.description: Device names the entry applies to; an empty array applies it to every device of the Kind.

TemplateValues.description: Device template variables for the {...} templates of the feature list.
